title: EvidenceItem
description: One observation with full provenance and an explicit epistemic status. 'proves' and 'does_not_prove' are both mandatory in spirit: evidence that is over-read is as dangerous as missing evidence.

artifact_type.description: e.g. tool_output, source_file, abi, bytecode, transaction, event_log, compiler_metadata, model_response

location.description: Where in the artifact, e.g. 'src/Pool.sol:142-168' or a tx hash with log index.

epistemic.description: FACT is directly observed. AI_OPINION is never promoted to FACT without independent verification.

excerpt.description: Verbatim content. Never paraphrased into existence.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the excerpt, so unaltered provenance is checkable.
